reuse.why: Changes the shared getScheduleAmount and routes the budget template through it instead of its inline midpoint, but ignores the parallel getScheduledAmount helper that already exists in the same module.

duplication.why: The diff removes one inline copy but leaves getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts computing the old midpoint, so two definitions of the range rule now disagree.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the module that owns schedule amount helpers.

scope.why: Only the rule, one call site, comments and its test.

maintainability.why: A maintainer now faces two near-identical exported helpers (getScheduleAmount vs getScheduledAmount) with different range semantics used by server and UI respectively.

one_place.where: getScheduleAmount (shared/schedules.ts) is changed, but getScheduledAmount in the same file, used by Balance.tsx, SchedulesTable.tsx, mobile schedules and useScheduleEdit, still computes the rounded midpoint
